Veterans Benefits: Texas has no state income tax, so military retirement pay is untaxed at the state level. Disabled veterans receive a rating-scaled residence-homestead exemption, and a 100% service-connected or individually unemployable veteran receives a total homestead property-tax exemption, with surviving-spouse continuation.

Description: Corpus Christi is a Gulf Coast Texas city and deepwater port anchored by Naval Air Station Corpus Christi and the Corpus Christi Army Depot (the Defense Department's largest helicopter overhaul facility). It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, Texas's no-income-tax treatment of military retirement pay, an HRC-rated municipal-equality score, beaches, and Walmart access. Tradeoffs include a high crime rate, Gulf hurricane exposure, and no local Costco.
